name: Integrity & accountability
description: We do what we say, honestly and consistently. We answer to the communities we serve, to our partners and to each other for how resources are used and what results follow.
commitment: We publish how funds are used and report back to the communities we work with.

name: Dignity
description: Every person is treated with respect, whatever their age, gender or circumstances. We listen first, protect privacy and never reduce people to their problems.
commitment: We ask for consent, protect personal stories and plan with people, not for them.

name: Inclusion
description: Women, girls, young people and the most vulnerable households are involved from the start, so nobody is left out of decisions or of the benefits.
commitment: We bring the quietest and most remote voices into planning meetings.

name: Equality
description: Girls and boys, women and men deserve the same chances to learn, earn and lead. We challenge the discrimination and violence that hold people back.
commitment: We design every programme so girls and boys, women and men benefit fairly.

name: Community ownership
description: Communities set the priorities and lead the work. Families, traditional leaders and local groups shape our programmes, so change lasts after a project ends.
commitment: Community members help choose, run and review each activity.

name: Innovation
description: We try practical ideas that fit local life, from climate-smart farming methods to new ways of keeping girls in school, and we learn quickly from what works.
commitment: We pilot new approaches, measure them and keep what helps people.

name: Sustainability
description: We build solutions that protect the environment, strengthen local livelihoods and keep working long after our support has ended.
commitment: We plan from day one for activities to continue locally without us.

name: Partnership
description: Resilience is a shared effort. We work with communities, government, schools, traditional leaders, civil society and supporters, and we share both credit and responsibility.
commitment: We agree roles and goals openly with every partner.

name: Transparency
description: We share openly what we plan, spend and achieve, and we report honestly on progress and on setbacks alike.
commitment: We share plans, budgets and results, including what fell short.
